name: MCP connector lifecycle
description: Discover MCP connector management through the real staging UI, create a test-owned connector, verify its authoritative ID, invoke a permitted operation, verify the identifiable execution, then clean up and verify cleanup server-side. Semantic steps resolve against fresh evidence; routes are not predeclared.

steps.goal: From FreeInference staging, open the Agents application and find MCP connector management

intervention.requiredAction: Complete Agents authentication in the attached browser tab.

steps.goal: Create a test-owned MCP connector with a unique test name and verify it appears with an authoritative ID

intervention.requiredAction: Approve the exact connector creation (principal, environment, resource, parameters).

steps.goal: Invoke one permitted read-only operation on the test-owned connector and verify an identifiable execution appears

action.goal: Delete the test-owned MCP connector created in this run and verify it no longer appears
